summary: Hercules Capital, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on May 5, 2026, reporting routine quarterly earnings and financial results for Q1 2026 under Item 2.02, along with a declaration of a $0.47 per share cash distribution under Item 8.01. The press releases discuss record debt and equity commitments, total investment income, net investment income per share, and a notes offering. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special-situation event occurred. This is a standard earnings and dividend announcement, not a special situation.
